newsitem.title: SIERRA LEONE: 50 people drown in Sierra Leone boat disaster.
newsitem.headline: 50 people drown in Sierra Leone boat disaster.

text.p: Fifty people, mostly local traders, drowned when their boat overturned in a river near the Sierra Leone capital, Freetown, police said on Tuesday.

Police said the navy recovered 15 bodies from the accident, which happened on Sunday on the Rokel river as the boat sailed from Bonthe Island to Freetown. A total of 60 passengers and crew were on board when it capsized in stormy weather.
Boat accidents are common in Sierra Leone, where dilapidated roads are made doubly unsafe by armed guerrillas, and traders resort increasingly to the use of river transport.
Thirty people drowned in a similar accident last month and a total of about 200 have now perished in boat disasters in the the last four months.
